findings.problem: LedgerWorkflow has no typestate enum for its lifecycle; status transitions are unenforced by the type system
findings.failure_mode: Any code can set fields into arbitrary combinations (e.g., is_sent=true with status not 'sent', or is_validated=false with is_sent=true), representing illegal ledger states at compile time
findings.fix: Replace status, is_validated, is_sent, and sent_at_epoch_ms with a single LedgerState enum with variants like New, Validated, Sent(SentInfo) where each variant owns exactly the data it needs

findings.problem: status is a String, allowing arbitrary invalid values like "", "SENT", "sent", or any future string
findings.failure_mode: Callers can construct LedgerWorkflow with any status string; pattern matching on status is impossible; typos produce silent logic errors instead of compile errors
findings.fix: Replace with a LedgerStatus enum with explicit variants (Pending, Sent) and derive Display for any string representation

findings.problem: is_validated: bool and is_sent: bool encode lifecycle state as independent booleans that can be set in invalid combinations
findings.failure_mode: A ledger can be is_validated=false and is_sent=true simultaneously, or is_sent=true but status="pending" — no type system enforces valid transitions, making the 4 boolean combinations include impossible and dangerous states
findings.fix: Replace both booleans with a single LedgerState enum typestate that encodes only valid transitions, e.g., LedgerState::New, LedgerState::Validated, LedgerState::Sent

findings.problem: sent_at_epoch_ms: Option<u64> is an optional field on the struct that can be None even when is_sent=true, or Some even when is_sent=false
findings.failure_mode: The Option field is decoupled from the is_sent boolean, creating states where a sent ledger has no timestamp or a non-sent ledger has a timestamp — both are logically inconsistent and undetectable by the type system
findings.fix: Embed sent_at_epoch_ms inside an enum variant that owns it: LedgerState::Sent { sent_at_epoch_ms: u64 }, removing both the Option and is_sent bool

findings.problem: id: String is a raw primitive with no domain constraints or newtype wrapper
findings.failure_mode: Any code can pass empty strings, unbounded strings, or non-unique strings as ledger IDs; the domain has no way to enforce uniqueness, format rules, or length bounds at the type level
findings.fix: Replace with a newtype LedgerId(String) with a smart constructor that validates non-empty and bounded, exposing only safe accessors

findings.problem: mark_sent accepts a raw mutable LedgerWorkflow struct directly; raw primitives cross the parse boundary without fallible smart constructors, so callers can construct invalid domain states directly
findings.failure_mode: No validation or typestate check guards the transition; mark_sent can be called on a LedgerWorkflow that was never validated, or one already marked sent, with no way to return a typed error for rejected transitions
findings.fix: Replace mark_sent with fn try_advance_to_sent(state: LedgerState) -> Result<LedgerState, TransitionError> that enforces typestate transitions and returns typed errors for invalid transitions

findings.problem: mark_sent blindly sets is_sent=true and status="sent" without checking is_validated, allowing an invalid ledger to enter the sent state
findings.failure_mode: A ledger that has not been validated (is_validated=false) can be marked as sent, violating the invariant that only validated ledgers may be sent — this is a domain logic error with no runtime or compile-time guard
findings.fix: Make the transition depend on the validated state: either require LedgerState::Validated as input and produce LedgerState::Sent, or return Result<LedgerState, TransitionError::NotValidated>

findings.problem: No tests exist in the crate; no behavior is verified for the ledger workflow or its state transitions
findings.failure_mode: No evidence that mark_sent produces correct behavior for any input, including edge cases like already-sent ledgers, unvalidated ledgers, or empty IDs
findings.fix: Add exhaustive behavior tests covering: valid transition from validated to sent, rejected transition from non-validated to sent, rejected double-send, and correct state encoding in each variant

residual_risk: Review is static-only with zero tests, zero benchmarks, zero command execution. The struct encodes illegal states (unvalidated sent, missing timestamps on sent ledgers, arbitrary status strings) with no compile-time or runtime guards. The typestate review requires 6 findings as mandated by the skill; all 8 findings above are complete with severity, rule, file, line, problem, failure_mode, and fix. Without typestate enforcement, the domain has no assurance that ledgers follow a valid lifecycle.
